references.view: Historical side view of Magasin 2 beside Saint-Germain-l’Auxerrois: framed multi-storey glazing, projecting floor bands and curving upper crowns. Used for facade rhythm; this older photograph does not establish the current renovated roof or exact dimensions.

modelingNotes: OSM defines the complete retail block, a northern 21 m mass and an internal rooflight polygon. The southern frontage has no mapped height: its retained interpretation has a 23 m main facade, terraces at 27 and 30 m with setbacks 1.6 and 3.5 m, and a 32 m roof crown. These dimensions are inferred, not surveyed.

The inspected 2025 Commons river-front view (e9796035, references/00.jpg) shows tall framed glazing between substantial Art Deco stone piers, gold-toned mullions, projecting balconies, stepped upper floors and pointed dormer crowns. Their rhythm and proportions guide detail within the saved footprint; small sculptures, flowers, mosaics and lettering are omitted.

The mapped internal rooflight retains an inferred 21 m eave/24 m ridge. Roof glazing uses glass and supported vertical facade panels use window. The selected historical side photograph references/02.jpg establishes the framed bays and projecting floor bands on Magasin 2; its curving crowns are interpreted schematically. This older view does not establish exact current roof dimensions, so the river-front silhouette follows the 2025 photo.

The walls are set back 0.5 m from the source outline to keep projecting piers and cornices within it; a low slab retains the complete plan. Six approved library finishes are used, with the spare metal role repurposed to invalides-gold for the fine gold-toned mullions/rails. Low LOD preserves the same terrace silhouette and main tall bays with fewer secondary divisions.
